baseline_check.method: Every exported baseline window/flow checked; numeric equality uses Decimal without tolerance. No rounding before comparison.

method.baseline_selection: Three-way display uses v1 baseline; v2 baseline is retained separately and exact baseline validation must pass before sharing conclusions.
method.decimals: Exact input decimal arithmetic; values/differences are decimal strings or integers, with no display rounding.
method.intervals: Exact matched [start,end); aggregate goodput uses all observed application bytes / full matched width.
method.jain: Only nonblank source Jain values when every included flow is active for the same complete window.
method.loss: TcDrop is distinct from device queue drops; RECOVERY/LOSS state entries are not RTO counters.
method.queue: Forward device FIFO, all dequeued packets, including zero wait; mean/p95 converted exactly ns to ms. Missing LEO direct queue values remain null.
method.renewals: Counts and maximum RENEW base RTT refer to the whole case, not each repeated comparison window.
